theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → (∀ η : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T η = tauAction (m + 1) M θ ξ η) → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (μ' : Measure (Eucl P)) (v' : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) m), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → IsMeasureRepresentation T.boundary μ' v' → ∀ (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (Lh : ℝ≥0) (Gh : Eucl P → Eucl P), LipschitzWith Lh h → Measurable Gh → (∀ x, ‖Gh x‖ ≤ Lh) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → Gh x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (Gh x) u) 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, (∫ x, h x * v' x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∂μ') - (∫ x, h x * v x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∂μ) = ∫ x in M, θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (Gh x)).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x))) ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))
